## Correct combine formula

For a query row, each rank computes a partial log-sum-exp over the blocks it
owns:

```
L_i = logsumexp(softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d))_i)   # scalar per rank i
O_i = sum_j softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d))_ij V_j   # (d,) per rank i
```

The global attention output is the weighted average of the per-rank outputs,
reweighted by the per-rank normalizers:

```
w_i = exp(L_i) / sum_k exp(L_k)
O   = sum_i w_i O_i
```

Equivalently, in log space:

```
L_global = logsumexp(L_1, ..., L_n)
O        = sum_i exp(L_i - L_global) O_i
```

This is the standard "reduce LSE" identity. It is exact and numerically stable
as long as every `L_i` is a finite real number.
